name: veritae-workflow
description: 10 role-based subagents (planner, api-architect, designer, ios-dev, spring-dev, qa, convention-checker, + 3 reviewers) powering AI-native development of Veritae, an iOS + Spring app. Released as a byproduct so other iOS+Spring teams can fork it. Per-role model selection (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku), ADR + lessons-learned history conventions built in.
